# cloptima_llm_gateway_effective_policy (Data Source)

Reads the effective gateway policy for a request scope or a virtual key: the policy that wins for that scope with the organization baseline layered on, the stricter value of each setting applying. Use it to check what governs a team, application, environment, or virtual key before traffic arrives.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# What governs the growth team's production traffic
data "cloptima_llm_gateway_effective_policy" "growth_prod" {
  team_id     = "growth"
  environment = "production"
  actor_type  = "service"
}

# What governs one virtual key
data "cloptima_llm_gateway_effective_policy" "copilot_key" {
  virtual_key_id = cloptima_llm_virtual_key.copilot.id
}

output "growth_prod_policy" {
  value = data.cloptima_llm_gateway_effective_policy.growth_prod.policy_name
}

output "growth_prod_org_daily_ceiling" {
  value = one([
    for setting in data.cloptima_llm_gateway_effective_policy.growth_prod.settings :
    jsondecode(setting.value) if setting.field == "orgDailyBudgetUsd"
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `actor_type` (String) Caller type: human or service.
- `app_id` (String) Application the request is attributed to.
- `environment` (String) Environment the request is attributed to.
- `team_id` (String) Team the request is attributed to.
- `virtual_key_id` (String) A virtual key ID. Resolves the key's own team, application, and environment as a service caller, as its traffic is resolved; team_id, app_id, environment, and actor_type are ignored.

### Read-Only

- `baseline_policy_id` (String) ID of the organization baseline policy, when the organization has one.
- `baseline_policy_name` (String) Name of the organization baseline policy, when the organization has one.
- `matched` (Boolean) Whether a bound policy governs this scope. Requests in a scope with no bound policy are refused.
- `policy_id` (String) ID of the winning policy.
- `policy_name` (String) Name of the winning policy.
- `reason` (String) Why no policy matched, when matched is false.
- `settings` (Attributes List) Each setting the organization baseline can also set, with its effective value and its source: winner, baseline, both, or unset. Allow lists report both sides, since a request must pass each. dailyBudgetUsd and monthlyBudgetUsd are the winning policy's own budgets; orgDailyBudgetUsd and orgMonthlyBudgetUsd are the baseline's ceiling on all gateway spend. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Read-Only:

- `field` (String) Setting name.
- `source` (String) Where the value comes from: winner, baseline, both, or unset.
- `value` (String) Effective value as JSON.
